metadata.title: Detailed CSE Reading Material
metadata.audience: CSE graduate candidates preparing for fundamentals, interviews, and written assessments
designNotes: Unicode sketches are used only where they stay compact.
Detailed visual study is delegated to curated reference links per topic.
Content is arranged topic-wise and difficulty-tagged Easy, Medium, or Hard.
Each topic includes learning objectives, notes, formulas/rules, traps, practice drills, and references.

globalStudyPlan: Round 1: Read every Easy topic and solve small examples until definitions are automatic.
Round 2: For each Medium topic, make a handwritten invariant/formula sheet and solve mixed MCQ/MSQ/code-trace questions.
Round 3: For each Hard topic, force yourself to explain edge cases, failure modes, and calculation shortcuts aloud.
Round 4: Revisit mistakes by classifying them as concept gap, formula gap, reading-comprehension gap, or careless arithmetic.
Round 5: Simulate timed tests with interleaved subjects; real assessments rarely group topics conveniently.
